node.title: OV slope-free obstruction reduction and minimal-degree branch
node.statement: For gate-clean zero-escape support systems, pair-unions are MDS-independent, triple-unions are MDS-dependent, and the intersection of all pair-unions is empty. If Ann is nonzero for some slope tuple, then the support-only space Jperp has dimension at least two; hence dim Jperp<=1 kills Ann for every slope tuple. Under the additional L=1, uniform-multiplicity, and characteristic hypotheses, the minimal-degree r=d branch is empty. The r>d branch and Conjecture OV remain open; no consumer is closed.
